vignette: A child with compromised immunity needs an invasive dental procedure. The dentist is deciding how to handle the risk of infection.
stem: Which plan is most consistent with current guidance?

options.text: Consult the child's physician and decide on antibiotic prophylaxis for this individual case.
Use clindamycin as the prophylactic agent.
Proceed without physician consultation, since immune compromise does not raise the risk of distant infection after invasive procedures.
Give the same prophylaxis to every patient regardless of individual circumstances.
